```{r}
# ============================================================
# RSV Wastewater Pipeline — Organized & Commented
# Jose Palacio — clean, modular R script
# Notes:
#   • Short, natural English comments explain each function and step.
#   • NIMBLE model code is commented line-by-line.
#   • Keep sections independent so you can source pieces in other projects.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Packages & global options
# ------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling + ggplot2
  library(lubridate)   # dates
  library(MARSS)       # state-space (Kalman) on log scale
  library(KFAS)        # extract filtered states from MARSS fits
  library(glue)        # tidy string helpers
  library(scales)      # axis labels
  library(ggnewscale)  # multiple color scales
  library(posterior)   # draws handling (optional)
  library(kableExtra)  # tables (optional)
  library(forecast)    # misc TS tools (optional)
  library(patchwork)
  library(qcc)         # control charts (optional)
  library(astsa)       # TS helpers (optional)
  library(tseries)     # TS tests (optional)
  library(loo)         # WAIC/LOO utilities
  library(truncnorm)   # truncated normals
  library(nimble)      # MCMC and custom models
  library(ern)         # ERN pkg if you compare methods
  library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble); library(htmltools); library(plotly)
  library(htmlwidgets); library(webshot); library(webshot2); library(knitr)
})

nimbleOptions(clearNimbleFunctionsAfterCompiling = TRUE)
set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper: build a wide T×(1+P) frame from long data
#    - Keeps column order consistent and fills missing plants
# ------------------------------------------------------------
make_wide_matrix <- function(df, value_col, plants_order) {
  df %>%
    mutate(.val = {{ value_col }}) %>%             # capture the column/expression as .val
    select(Date, WWTP, .val) %>%                   # only the columns we need
    tidyr::pivot_wider(                            # long → wide; one column per plant
      names_from = WWTP, values_from = .val,
      values_fill = NA_real_
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    {
      wide <- .
      missing_cols <- setdiff(plants_order, names(wide)) # ensure all plants exist as columns
      if (length(missing_cols)) for (m in missing_cols) wide[[m]] <- NA_real_
      wide %>% select(all_of(c("Date", plants_order))) # enforce column order
    }
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Load RSV rows and basic cleaning
#    - Expect: date, WWTP, tn (pathogen), log10cpl, flow_interp (L/day)
#    - If flow is in MGD, convert before this step
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ww <- read_csv("~/Downloads/all_ts_observed_ILI.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(WWTP = toupper(WWTP), tn = toupper(tn)) %>%
  filter(WWTP != "SS", tn == "RSV") %>%
  transmute(
    Batch    = BATCH,
    WWTP,
    Date     = as.Date(date),
    Pathogen = tn,
    copies_day,
    lcopies_day,
    copies_L,
    log10cpl,
    Flow     = flow_interp     # L/day
  ) %>%
  arrange(WWTP, Date)


library(dplyr)

ww_batch <- ww %>%
  group_by(Batch, Date, Pathogen) %>%     # si Pathogen siempre es RSV, es más por claridad
  summarise(
    copies_day = mean(copies_day, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_plants   = n_distinct(WWTP),        # cuántas plantas entraron en ese batch
    .groups    = "drop"
  )



population <- read_csv("~/Downloads/all_ts_observed_ILI.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(WWTP = toupper(WWTP), tn = toupper(tn)) %>%
  filter(tn == "RSV", WWTP != "SS") %>%
  select(WWTP, pop) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(pop)) %>%                        # opcional: descarta pop NA del denominador
  mutate(
    prop     = pop / sum(pop),                   # proporción por planta
    avg_case = pmax(1L, as.integer(round(213 * prop)))  # mínimo 1
  )

conc_codes   <- sort(unique(ww$WWTP))
WWTP_focus   <- c("69")
WWTP_focus   <- WWTP_focus[WWTP_focus %in% conc_codes]
plants_order <- WWTP_focus
avg_cases <- population  %>%filter(WWTP == WWTP_focus) %>% select(avg_case)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Burn-in and trimming
#    - Drop early dates (stabilization period)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
burnin <- 15

date_burnin <- ww %>%
  filter(WWTP %in% WWTP_focus) %>%
  summarise(date_burnin = dplyr::nth(sort(unique(Date)), burnin, default = max(Date))) %>%
  pull(date_burnin)

ww_rsv <- ww %>%
  filter(WWTP %in% WWTP_focus, Date > date_burnin, Date >= as.Date("2023-01-02")) %>%
  mutate(
    Missing = is.na(log10cpl),
    cpl     = copies_L                # gc/L
  ) %>%
  relocate(WWTP, Date, Pathogen, log10cpl, cpl, Flow, Missing) %>%
  arrange(WWTP, Date) %>%
  select(-c("copies_L"))

dates_rsv <- sort(unique(ww_rsv$Date))
Tt <- length(dates_rsv)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Median flow per plant (constant across time for CPD calc)
#    - We purposely use the plant-level median to reduce noise
# ------------------------------------------------------------
median_flow_tbl <- ww_rsv %>%
  group_by(WWTP) %>%
  summarise(Flow_median = median(Flow, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

median_flow_vec <- median_flow_tbl %>%
  right_join(tibble(WWTP = plants_order), by = "WWTP") %>%
  arrange(WWTP) %>%
  pull(Flow_median)

median_flow_TxP <- matrix(rep(median_flow_vec, each = Tt), nrow = Tt, ncol = length(plants_order))
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) CPD in billions & log transforms
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# gc/L wide matrix
wide_cpl <- make_wide_matrix(ww_rsv, value_col = cpl, plants_order)
mat_rsv_cpl <- as.matrix(wide_cpl[,-1])                      # T×P (gc/L)

# Billions of copies/day (using median flow)
mat_rsv_cpd_b <- (mat_rsv_cpl * median_flow_TxP) / 1e9      # T×P (billions CPD)
wide_cpd_b <- wide_cpl; wide_cpd_b[,-1] <- mat_rsv_cpd_b

mat_rsv_cpd_log10 <- 10^ww_rsv$lcopies_day/1e9 #log10(mat_rsv_cpd_b)

# Log10 versions
mat_rsv_log10cpl   <- log10(mat_rsv_cpl)        # T×P
mat_rsv_log10cpd_b <- log10(mat_rsv_cpd_b)

# Long frames for plots
df_long_cpl_b <- make_wide_matrix(ww_rsv, value_col = cpl, plants_order) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "WWTP", values_to = "cpl_b") %>%
  left_join(ww_rsv %>% select(WWTP, Date, Missing) %>% distinct(), by = c("WWTP","Date")) %>%
  arrange(WWTP, Date)

df_long_cpd_b <- wide_cpd_b %>%
  pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "WWTP", values_to = "cpd_b") %>%
  arrange(WWTP, Date)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```
```{r}
# 7a) MARSS on log10(billions CPD) — simple 2-dim state
#    - We fit, then map back to natural scale with lognormal correction
# ------------------------------------------------------------
model.spec <- list(
  B  = matrix(c(2,1,-1,0), 2, 2, byrow = TRUE), # simple stable 2×2 dynamics
  U  = "zero",                                   # no intercept in state eq
  Q  = "diagonal and equal",                    # same process var per state
  V0 = "identity",                              # initial state var
  x0 = "equal",                                 # same initial mean
  R  = "diagonal and equal",                    # obs noise (equal across plants)
  A  = "zero",                               # no mean offset in obs eq
  Z  = { Ztmp <- matrix(list(0), nrow = length(plants_order), ncol = 2);
         Ztmp[,1] <- 1; Ztmp }                   # first state loads on all plants
)

fit_cpd_b <- MARSS(t(mat_rsv_log10cpd_b), model = model.spec,
                   method = "BFGS", silent = TRUE, control = list(trace = 1))

# Filtered states → plant scale (natural units, billions CPD) with lognormal correction
kfas <- MARSSkfas(fit_cpd_b)
xtt  <- kfas$xtt                             # m × T (filtered means)
Vtt  <- kfas$Vtt                            # m × m × T (filtered covariances)
M    <- coef(fit_cpd_b, type = "matrix")
Z    <- as.matrix(M$Z)                       # P × m
R    <- as.matrix(M$R)                       # P × P (log10 scale)
P    <- nrow(Z); Tt <- ncol(xtt)

R_log10 <- as.matrix(M$R)
sd_log10_obs <- sqrt(diag(R_log10))
sigma_ln <- log(10) * sd_log10_obs

mu_log10 <- sd_log10 <- matrix(NA_real_, P, Tt)
for (t in 1:Tt) {
  mu_log10[, t] <- drop(Z %*% xtt[, t])                # mean on log10 scale
  Sigma_y_t     <- Z %*% Vtt[,, t] %*% t(Z)        # var on log10 scale
  sd_log10[, t] <- sqrt(pmax(diag(Sigma_y_t), 0))
}

ln10   <- log(10)

  
sdlog_TxP   <- t(ln10 * sd_log10)
mu_ln  <- ln10 * mu_log10
var_ln <- (ln10^2) * (sd_log10^2)
mean_cpd_b <- exp(mu_ln + 0.5 * var_ln)               # mean on natural scale
log((exp(sdlog_TxP^2)-1)*(exp(2*t(mu_ln) + sdlog_TxP^2)))

df_cpd_b_est <- tibble(
  Date = rep(dates_rsv, each = P),
  WWTP = rep(plants_order, times = Tt),
  mean = as.vector(mean_cpd_b),
  sd   = as.vector(sd_cpd_b),
  lwr  = pmax(mean - 1.96*sd, 0),
  upr  = mean + 1.96*sd
)

p_marss <- ggplot(df_cpd_b_est, aes(Date, mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = df_long_cpd_b, aes(y = cpd_b), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(title = "RSV — MARSS estimated vs observed (billions CPD, median flow)",
       x = "Date", y = "Billions of copies per day (10^9 cp/day)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")

print(p_marss)

# P×T pseudo-observations for downstream models
y_kf_cpd_TxP_b <- t(mean_cpd_b)                     # T×P (means on natural scale)
sigma_cpd_b    <- t(sqrt(var_ln))   # T×P (sd on ln-scale)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7b) MARSS on log10(CPL) — simple 2-dim state
#    - We fit, then map back to natural scale with lognormal correction
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fit_cpl <- MARSS(t(mat_rsv_log10cpl), model = model.spec,
                   method = "BFGS", silent = TRUE, control = list(trace = 1))
# Filtered states → plant scale (natural units, gc/L) with lognormal correction
kfas_cpl <- MARSSkfas(fit_cpl)
xtt_cpl  <- kfas_cpl$xtt                             # m × T (filtered means)
Vtt_cpl  <- kfas_cpl$Vtt                             # m × m × T (filtered covariances)
M_cpl    <- coef(fit_cpl, type = "matrix")
Z_cpl    <- as.matrix(M_cpl$Z)                       # P × m
R_cpl    <- as.matrix(M_cpl$R)                       # P × P (log10 scale)
P        <- nrow(Z_cpl); Tt <- ncol(xtt_cpl)
mu_log10_cpl <- sd_log10_cpl <- matrix(NA_real_, P, Tt)
for (t in 1:Tt) {
  mu_log10_cpl[, t] <- drop(Z_cpl %*% xtt_cpl[, t])                # mean on log10 scale
  Sigma_y_t         <- Z_cpl %*% Vtt_cpl[,, t] %*% t(Z_cpl) + R_cpl        # var on log10 scale
  sd_log10_cpl[, t] <- sqrt(pmax(diag(Sigma_y_t), 0))
}
mu_ln_cpl  <- ln10 * mu_log10_cpl
var_ln_cpl <- (ln10^2) * (sd_log10_cpl^2)
sigma_ln_cpl <- t(sqrt(var_ln_cpl))   # T×P (sd on ln-scale)
mean_cpl <- exp(mu_ln_cpl + 0.5 * var_ln_cpl) # mean on natural scale
y_kf_cpl_TxP <- t(mean_cpl) # T×P (means on natural scale)

sd_cpl   <- sqrt((exp(var_ln_cpl) - 1) * exp(2 * mu_ln_cpl + var_ln_cpl))
df_cpl_est <- tibble(
  Date = rep(dates_rsv, each = P),
  WWTP = rep(plants_order, times = Tt),
  mean = as.vector(mean_cpl),
  sd   = as.vector(sd_cpl),
  lwr  = pmax(mean - 1.96*sd, 0),
  upr  = mean + 1.96*sd
)
p_marss_cpl <- ggplot(df_cpl_est, aes(Date, mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = df_long_cpl_b, aes(y = cpl_b), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(title = "RSV — MARSS estimated vs observed (gc/L)",
       x = "Date", y = "copies per liter (gc/L)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")
print(p_marss_cpl)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot genérico para estimados filtrados en escala log10
# ============================================================
plot_log10_filtered <- function(mu_log10, sd_log10, dates, plants, y_obs_log10,
                                ylab = expression(log[10]~("value")),
                                title = "Filtered vs observed (log10)") {
  P  <- length(plants)
  Tt <- length(dates)

  df_est <- tibble(
    Date = rep(dates, each = P),
    WWTP = rep(plants, times = Tt),
    mean = as.vector(mu_log10),
    sd   = as.vector(sd_log10),
    lwr  = mean - 1.96 * sd,
    upr  = mean + 1.96 * sd
  )

  df_obs <- tibble(
    Date = rep(dates, each = P),
    WWTP = rep(plants, times = Tt),
    y    = as.vector(y_obs_log10)
  )

  ggplot(df_est, aes(Date, mean)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(data = df_obs, aes(y = y), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Date", y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "none")
}

# ============================================================
# 1) LOG10(CPD) — usa objetos de la sección 7a
#    mu_log10, sd_log10 ya calculados arriba para CPD
# ============================================================
# Observaciones en log10(CPD) (T×P)
y_obs_log10_cpd <- mat_rsv_log10cpd_b  # ya lo tienes

p_log10_cpd <- plot_log10_filtered(
  mu_log10   = mu_log10,          # P×T
  sd_log10   = sd_log10,          # P×T
  dates      = dates_rsv,
  plants     = plants_order,
  y_obs_log10= y_obs_log10_cpd,   # T×P
  ylab       = expression(log[10]~"copies/day"),
  title      = "RSV — MARSS filtered vs observed (log10 CPD, median flow)"
)
print(p_log10_cpd)

# ============================================================
# 2) LOG10(CPL) — usa objetos de la sección 7b
#    mu_log10_cpl, sd_log10_cpl ya calculados para CPL
# ============================================================
y_obs_log10_cpl <- mat_rsv_log10cpl     # T×P

p_log10_cpl <- plot_log10_filtered(
  mu_log10   = mu_log10_cpl,       # P×T
  sd_log10   = sd_log10_cpl,       # P×T
  dates      = dates_rsv,
  plants     = plants_order,
  y_obs_log10= y_obs_log10_cpl,    # T×P
  ylab       = expression(log[10]~"copies/L"),
  title      = "RSV — MARSS filtered vs observed (log10 CPL)"
)
print(p_log10_cpl)

# Usar SMOOTHED states en vez de FILTERED
kfas <- MARSSkfas(fit_cpd_b)
x_sm  <- kfas$xtt            # m × T
V_sm  <- kfas$Vtt            # m × m × T

M    <- coef(fit_cpd_b, type = "matrix")
Z    <- as.matrix(M$Z)       # P × m
R    <- as.matrix(M$R)       # P × P (log10)

P <- nrow(Z); Tt <- ncol(x_sm)

# Elige si incluir R (observación esperada) o no (señal latente)
include_R <- FALSE  # <-- pon TRUE si quieres las bandas de "y_t" con ruido de medición

mu_log10 <- sd_log10 <- matrix(NA_real_, P, Tt)
for (t in 1:Tt) {
  mu_log10[, t] <- drop(Z %*% x_sm[, t])
  Sigma_t <- Z %*% V_sm[,, t] %*% t(Z)
  if (include_R) Sigma_t <- Sigma_t + R
  sd_log10[, t] <- sqrt(pmax(diag(Sigma_t), 0))
}

# Bandas CORRECTAS para lognormal: calcular en log10 y luego transformar
lwr_nat <- 10^(mu_log10 - 1.96*sd_log10)
upr_nat <- 10^(mu_log10 + 1.96*sd_log10)

# Para la curva central en natural, usa la MEDIANA (más robusta que la media)
median_nat <- 10^(mu_log10)

df_cpd_b_est <- tibble(
  Date = rep(dates_rsv, each = P),
  WWTP = rep(plants_order, times = Tt),
  med  = as.vector(median_nat),
  lwr  = as.vector(lwr_nat),
  upr  = as.vector(upr_nat)
)

p_marss_tight <- ggplot(df_cpd_b_est, aes(Date, med)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = df_long_cpd_b, aes(y = cpd_b), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(title = glue("RSV — MARSS {if (include_R) 'expected obs' else 'latent signal'} vs observed (CPD)"),
       x = "Date", y = "Copies Per Day (cp/day)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")
print(p_marss_tight)

df_log10 <- tibble(
  Date = rep(dates_rsv, each = P),
  WWTP = rep(plants_order, times = Tt),
  mean = as.vector(mu_log10),
  lwr  = as.vector(mu_log10 - 1.96*sd_log10),
  upr  = as.vector(mu_log10 + 1.96*sd_log10),
  obs  = as.vector(mat_rsv_log10cpd_b)
)

ggplot(df_log10, aes(Date, mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(y = obs), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(title = "RSV — MARSS filtered (log10 CPD)", y = expression(log[10]~"copies/day")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Construye el long data frame en cp/day
df_long_cpd <- tibble(
  Date = rep(dates_rsv, each = length(plants_order)),
  WWTP = rep(plants_order, times = length(dates_rsv)),
  cpd  = as.vector(mat_rsv_cpd_b)   # matriz T×P en cp/day
)

mu_ln  <- log(10) * mu_log10
var_ln <- (log(10)^2) * (sd_log10^2)
median_cpd <- exp(mu_ln)  # mediana lognormal en cp/day
lwr_cpd    <- exp(mu_ln - 1.96*sqrt(var_ln))
upr_cpd    <- exp(mu_ln + 1.96*sqrt(var_ln))

df_est <- tibble(
  Date = rep(dates_rsv, each = P),
  WWTP = rep(plants_order, times = Tt),
  med  = as.vector(median_cpd),
  lwr  = as.vector(lwr_cpd),
  upr  = as.vector(upr_cpd)
)

ggplot(df_est, aes(Date, med)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lwr, ymax=upr), alpha=.15) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = df_long_cpd, aes(y = cpd), size=.7, alpha=.7) +  # <-- cp/day
  labs(title="RSV — MARSS latent vs observed (CPD)",
       y="Copies per day (cp/day)")
```

```{r}
# ---------- A.1  gc/L wide & log10 ----------
wide_cpl       <- make_wide_matrix(ww_rsv, value_col = cpl, plants_order)
mat_rsv_cpl    <- as.matrix(wide_cpl[,-1])             # T×P (gc/L)
mat_rsv_log10cpl <- log10(mat_rsv_cpl)                 # T×P

# ---------- A.2  long tidy para plots ----------
df_long_cpl <- make_wide_matrix(ww_rsv, value_col = cpl, plants_order) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "WWTP", values_to = "cpl") %>%
  left_join(ww_rsv %>% select(WWTP, Date, Missing) %>% distinct(), by = c("WWTP","Date")) %>%
  arrange(WWTP, Date)

# ---------- B.1  MARSS sobre log10(CPL) ----------
fit_cpl <- MARSS(t(mat_rsv_log10cpl), model = model.spec,
                 method = "BFGS", silent = TRUE, control = list(trace = 1))

kfas_cpl <- MARSSkfas(fit_cpl)
xtt_cpl  <- kfas_cpl$xtt            # m × T
Vtt_cpl  <- kfas_cpl$Vtt            # m × m × T
M_cpl    <- coef(fit_cpl, type = "matrix")
Z_cpl    <- as.matrix(M_cpl$Z)      # P × m
R_cpl    <- as.matrix(M_cpl$R)      # P × P (en log10)

P <- nrow(Z_cpl); Tt <- ncol(xtt_cpl)
mu_log10_cpl <- sd_log10_cpl <- matrix(NA_real_, P, Tt)
for (t in 1:Tt) {
  mu_log10_cpl[, t] <- drop(Z_cpl %*% xtt_cpl[, t])
  Sigma_y_t         <- Z_cpl %*% Vtt_cpl[,, t] %*% t(Z_cpl) + R_cpl
  sd_log10_cpl[, t] <- sqrt(pmax(diag(Sigma_y_t), 0))
}

# ---------- B.2  pasar a natural (gc/L) con corrección lognormal ----------
ln10          <- log(10)
meanlog_TxP   <- t(ln10 * mu_log10_cpl)                  # T×P, ln-mean
sdlog_TxP_cpl     <- t(ln10 * sd_log10_cpl)                  # T×P, ln-sd
y_kf_cpl_TxP  <- exp(meanlog_TxP + 0.5 * (sdlog_TxP^2))  # T×P, media natural (gc/L)

# (opcional) bandas en natural, si quieres plotear:
lwr_cpl <- exp(meanlog_TxP - 1.96*sdlog_TxP)
upr_cpl <- exp(meanlog_TxP + 1.96*sdlog_TxP)


# ---------- C.1  Observado gc/L ----------
p_cpl <- ggplot(df_long_cpl, aes(Date, cpl)) +
  geom_rect(data = {
      dt_tbl <- df_long_cpl %>%
        group_by(WWTP) %>% summarise(dt = median(as.numeric(diff(sort(unique(Date)))), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        mutate(dt = ifelse(is.na(dt) | dt <= 0, 7, dt))
      range_dates <- range(df_long_cpl$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
      df_long_cpl %>% filter(coalesce(Missing, FALSE)) %>%
        left_join(dt_tbl, by = "WWTP") %>%
        transmute(WWTP,
                  xmin = pmax(Date - dt/2, range_dates[1]),
                  xmax = pmin(Date + dt/2, range_dates[2]),
                  ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
    },
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.30) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "copies per liter (gc/L)",
       title = "RSV concentration (gc/L), grey = missing") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")

print(p_cpl)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) General helpers for renewal/Kalman linkage
# ------------------------------------------------------------
assert_data_ok <- function(y_PT, sigma_obs_PT_or_NULL = NULL) {
  # Quick sanity checks on input matrices
  stopifnot(is.matrix(y_PT), all(is.finite(y_PT) | is.na(y_PT)))
  if (!is.null(sigma_obs_PT_or_NULL)) {
    stopifnot(is.matrix(sigma_obs_PT_or_NULL))
    stopifnot(all(dim(sigma_obs_PT_or_NULL) == dim(y_PT)))
  }
}

# Collapse T×P or P×T sigmas into a per-plant vector via median (robust)
sigma_obs_to_vec <- function(sig_mat, y_is_T_by_P) {
  if (y_is_T_by_P) {
    apply(sig_mat, 2, function(v) median(v[is.finite(v)], na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    apply(sig_mat, 1, function(v) median(v[is.finite(v)], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# Ensure P×T orientation (convenience for NIMBLE)
as_PT_matrix <- function(y, y_is_T_by_P = TRUE) {
  y <- as.matrix(y)
  if (y_is_T_by_P) t(y) else y
}

# Gamma params from mean/sd in days (return weeks)
to_gamma <- function(mean_days, sd_days){
  m <- mean_days/7; s <- sd_days/7
  list(shape = (m^2)/(s^2), scale = (s^2)/m)
}

# Discrete generation (g, 1..K) and shedding (d, 0..K) kernels
make_kernels <- function(mean_gen_days, sd_gen_days,
                         mean_shed_days, sd_shed_days, K = 3) {
  par_g <- to_gamma(mean_gen_days,  sd_gen_days)
  par_d <- to_gamma(mean_shed_days, sd_shed_days)

  # g over {1,2,...,K}
  edges_g_hi <- seq(1.5, K + 0.5, by = 1)
  w_g <- pgamma(edges_g_hi,     shape = par_g$shape, scale = par_g$scale) -
         pgamma(edges_g_hi - 1, shape = par_g$shape, scale = par_g$scale)
  w_g <- pmax(w_g, 0); w_g <- w_g / sum(w_g)

  # d over {0,1,...,K}
  edges_d <- c(-0.5, seq(0.5, K + 0.5, by = 1))
  F_d <- pgamma(pmax(edges_d, 0), shape = par_d$shape, scale = par_d$scale)
  w_d <- diff(F_d)
  w_d <- pmax(w_d, 0); w_d <- w_d / sum(w_d)

  list(g = w_g, d = w_d)
}

# Optional: visualize the continuous gamma shapes in weeks
plot_gamma_pdfs_weeks <- function(mean_gen_days  = 7.5, sd_gen_days  = 2.1,
                                  mean_shed_days = 4.6, sd_shed_days = 2.0,
                                  n = 600, save_png = NULL) {
  par_g <- to_gamma(mean_gen_days,  sd_gen_days)
  par_d <- to_gamma(mean_shed_days, sd_shed_days)
  tmax <- max((mean_gen_days + 3*sd_gen_days)/7,
              (mean_shed_days + 3*sd_shed_days)/7)
  t <- seq(0, tmax, length.out = n)

  df <- bind_rows(
    tibble(
      t = t,
      density = dgamma(t, shape = par_g$shape, scale = par_g$scale),
      kernel = glue("Generation (shape={round(par_g$shape,2)}, scale={round(par_g$scale,2)})")
    ),
    tibble(
      t = t,
      density = dgamma(t, shape = par_d$shape, scale = par_d$scale),
      kernel = glue("Shedding (shape={round(par_d$shape,2)}, scale={round(par_d$scale,2)})")
    )
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(t, density, color = kernel)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = "Continuous Gamma (weeks)", x = "Time (weeks)", y = "Density", color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  if (!is.null(save_png)) ggsave(save_png, p, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
  p
}

plot_gamma_pdfs_weeks(mean_gen_days = 7.5, sd_gen_days = 2.1,
                      mean_shed_days = 4.6, sd_shed_days = 2.0)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) NIMBLE low-level helpers (small, focused)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convolution sum over x[t-k] * w[k], k = 1..len (generation-style)
convSum <- nimble::nimbleFunction(
  run = function(t = integer(0), x = double(1), len = integer(0), w = double(1)) {
    returnType(double(0))
    out <- 0.0
    for (k in 1:len) if (t - k >= 1) out <- out + x[t - k] * w[k]
    return(out)
  })

# Convolution sum over x[t-k] * w[k+1], k = 0..len-1 (shedding-style with lag 0)
convSum0 <- nimble::nimbleFunction(
  run = function(t = integer(0), x = double(1), len = integer(0), w = double(1)) {
    returnType(double(0))
    out <- 0.0
    for (k in 0:(len - 1)) if (t - k >= 1) out <- out + x[t - k] * w[k + 1]
    return(out)
  })

# Numerically stable softplus: log(1 + exp(x)) for x<0, x + log(1+exp(-x)) for x>0
softplus_stable <- nimble::nimbleFunction(
  run = function(x = double(0)) {
    returnType(double(0))
    if (x > 0) return(x + log(1 + exp(-x))) else return(log(1 + exp(x)))
  })
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) MAIN: Renewal model in NIMBLE (commented line-by-line)
#      - y: measurements on natural scale (e.g., billions CPD)
#      - sigma_mode controls obs sd on ln-scale: fixed/plant/time/scalar
# ------------------------------------------------------------
fit_rsv_renewal_nimble <- function(
  y,                        # data: T×P (default) or P×T
  y_is_T_by_P = TRUE,       # set FALSE if y is P×T already
  sigma_mode = c("fixed","plant","time","scalar"),
  sigma_input = NULL,       # fixed: vector P or matrix P×T/T×P (sd on ln)
  mean_gen_days  = 7.5, sd_gen_days  = 2.1,
  mean_shed_days = 4.6, sd_shed_days = 2.0,
  K = 4,                   # kernel truncation length
  estimate_beta = TRUE, beta_fixed = NULL,
  iter = 50000, nburnin = NULL, thin = 1, nchains = 4,
  seed = 123,
  rw_logsigma0 = log(0.7), # prior center for log σ (time-varying mode)
  rw_sd_init   = 0.3,      # RW step sd (time-varying mode)
  inits_list = NULL
){
  set.seed(seed)
  sigma_mode <- match.arg(sigma_mode)

  # Orient as P×T for NIMBLE arrays
  y_PT <- as_PT_matrix(y, y_is_T_by_P = y_is_T_by_P)
  P <- nrow(y_PT); Tt <- ncol(y_PT)

  # Build discrete kernels
  ks <- make_kernels(mean_gen_days, sd_gen_days, mean_shed_days, sd_shed_days, K)
  g <- ks$g; d <- ks$d; G <- length(g); D <- length(d)

  # Select sigma mode constant to branch inside model
  SIGMA_MODE <- switch(sigma_mode, fixed=0L, plant=1L, time=2L, scalar=3L)

  sigma_fixed_PT <- NULL
  sigma_scalar   <- NULL

  if (SIGMA_MODE == 0L) {                 # fixed P×T or per-plant
    if (is.null(sigma_input))
      stop("sigma_mode='fixed' requires sigma_input (vector P or matrix P×T/T×P) on ln sd.")
    if (is.vector(sigma_input)) {
      stopifnot(length(sigma_input) == P, all(is.finite(sigma_input)), all(sigma_input > 0))
      sigma_fixed_PT <- matrix(as.numeric(sigma_input), nrow = P, ncol = Tt)
    } else if (is.matrix(sigma_input)) {
      if (all(dim(sigma_input) == c(P, Tt))) sigma_fixed_PT <- sigma_input else
      if (all(dim(sigma_input) == c(Tt, P))) sigma_fixed_PT <- t(sigma_input) else
        stop("sigma_input must be vector P or matrix P×T/T×P.")
      stopifnot(all(is.finite(sigma_fixed_PT)), all(sigma_fixed_PT > 0))
    }
    sigma_fixed_PT <- pmax(sigma_fixed_PT, 1e-6)
  } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 3L) {          # scalar
    if (is.null(sigma_input)) stop("sigma_mode='scalar' requires a scalar ln sd.")
    stopifnot(length(sigma_input) == 1, is.finite(sigma_input), sigma_input > 0)
    sigma_scalar <- as.numeric(sigma_input)
  }

  USE_EST_BETA <- as.integer(estimate_beta)
  if (!estimate_beta) {
    if (is.null(beta_fixed)) stop("If estimate_beta=FALSE, provide beta_fixed (vector P).")
    stopifnot(length(beta_fixed) == P, all(beta_fixed > 0), all(is.finite(beta_fixed)))
  }

  # ---------------------
  # NIMBLE model code
  # ---------------------
  code <- nimble::nimbleCode({
    for (p in 1:P) {                                                   # loop plants
      k[p]         ~ T(dlnorm(log(8), 1), 0.5, 20)                     # scaling for softplus
      sigma_eps[p] ~ T(dlnorm(log(0.5), 0.5), 0, Inf)                      # RW step sd for z
      z[p,1] ~ dnorm(1, sd = sigma_eps[p])                             # init latent driver
      for (t in 2:T) { z[p,t] ~ dnorm(z[p,t-1], sd = sigma_eps[p]) }   # Gaussian RW in time
      for (t in 1:T) { Rt[p,t] <- softplus_stable(k[p] * z[p,t]) / k[p] } # positive Rt via softplus

      It[p,1] ~ dpois(61)                                             # weakly-informative start
      for (t in 2:T) {                                                 # renewal infections
        iota[p,t] <- Rt[p,t] * convSum(t, It[p,1:(t-1)], G, g[1:G])    # lambda_t = Rt * (g * I)
        It[p,t]   ~ dpois(iota[p,t])                                   # infections at time t
      }

      if (USE_EST_BETA == 1) {                                         # scale to observations
        log_beta[p] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 2)                                 # log-normal prior
        beta[p]     <- exp(log_beta[p])
      } else {
        beta[p] <- beta_fixed[p]
      }

      if (SIGMA_MODE == 1) {                                           # per-plant ln sd
        sigma_obs_pl[p] ~ T(dnorm(0.5, sd = 0.5), 0.05, 3)
      } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 2) {                                    # time-varying ln sd
        log_sigma[p,1] ~ dnorm(rw_logsigma0, sd = 0.5)
        sigma_sigmarw[p] ~ T(dnorm(0, sd = rw_sd_init), 0.01, 2)
        for (t in 2:T) { log_sigma[p,t] ~ dnorm(log_sigma[p,t-1], sd = sigma_sigmarw[p]) }
        for (t in 1:T) { sigma_obs_tv[p,t] <- exp(log_sigma[p,t]) }
      }

      for (t in 1:T) {                                                 # observation model
        psi[p,t] <- beta[p] * convSum0(t, It[p,1:t], D, d[1:D])        # expected signal
        if (SIGMA_MODE == 0) {
          mu_obs[p,t] <- log(psi[p,t] + 1e-6) - 0.5 * (sigma_obs[p,t]^2) # fixed ln sd
          y[p,t] ~ dlnorm(mu_obs[p,t], sdlog = sigma_obs[p,t])
        } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 1) {
          mu_obs[p,t] <- log(psi[p,t] + 1e-6) - 0.5 * (sigma_obs_pl[p]^2) # plant ln sd
          y[p,t] ~ dlnorm(mu_obs[p,t], sdlog = sigma_obs_pl[p])
        } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 2) {
          mu_obs[p,t] <- log(psi[p,t] + 1e-6) - 0.5 * (sigma_obs_tv[p,t]^2) # tv ln sd
          y[p,t] ~ dlnorm(mu_obs[p,t], sdlog = sigma_obs_tv[p,t])
        } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 3) {
          mu_obs[p,t] <- log(psi[p,t] + 1e-6) - 0.5 * (sigma_scalar^2) # scalar ln sd
          y[p,t] ~ dlnorm(mu_obs[p,t], sdlog = sigma_scalar)
        }
      }
    }
  })

  consts <- list(P=P, T=Tt, G=G, D=D,
                 SIGMA_MODE=SIGMA_MODE, USE_EST_BETA=USE_EST_BETA,
                 rw_logsigma0=rw_logsigma0, rw_sd_init=rw_sd_init)
  if (SIGMA_MODE == 0L) consts$sigma_obs    <- sigma_fixed_PT
  if (SIGMA_MODE == 3L) consts$sigma_scalar <- sigma_scalar
  if (!estimate_beta)   consts$beta_fixed   <- as.numeric(beta_fixed)

  dataList <- list(y=y_PT, g=g, d=d)

  # Default inits if none provided (kept simple & stable)
  if (is.null(nburnin)) nburnin <- floor(0.1 * iter)
  if (is.null(inits_list)) {
    inits_list <- list(
      It        = matrix(1, nrow=P, ncol=Tt),
      z         = matrix(1, nrow=P, ncol=Tt),
      k         = rep(8, P),
      sigma_eps = rep(2, P)
    )
    if (estimate_beta) inits_list$log_beta <- rep(0, P)
    if (SIGMA_MODE == 1L) {
      inits_list$sigma_obs_pl <- rep(0.7, P)
    } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 2L) {
      inits_list$log_sigma     <- matrix(rw_logsigma0, nrow=P, ncol=Tt)
      inits_list$sigma_sigmarw <- rep(0.1, P)
    }
  }

  # Compile + MCMC
  model  <- nimble::nimbleModel(code, constants=consts, data=dataList, inits=inits_list, check=TRUE)
  cmodel <- nimble::compileNimble(model)

  monitors_main <- c("k","sigma_eps","It")
  monitors_aux  <- c("Rt")
  if (estimate_beta) monitors_aux <- c(monitors_aux, "beta")
  if (SIGMA_MODE == 1L) monitors_aux <- c(monitors_aux, "sigma_obs_pl")
  if (SIGMA_MODE == 2L) monitors_aux <- c(monitors_aux, "sigma_obs_tv","sigma_sigmarw")

  conf  <- nimble::configureMCMC(cmodel, monitors=monitors_main, monitors2=monitors_aux,
                                 useConjugacy=FALSE, enableWAIC=TRUE)
  Rmcmc <- nimble::buildMCMC(conf)
  cMcmc <- nimble::compileNimble(Rmcmc, project=model)

  t0 <- Sys.time()
  out <- nimble::runMCMC(cMcmc, niter=iter, nburnin=nburnin, thin=thin, nchains=nchains,
                         samplesAsCodaMCMC=TRUE, summary=TRUE, WAIC=TRUE)
  elapsed <- Sys.time() - t0

  # Safe extractor for draws → array[draws,P,T]
  .extract_any <- function(out_obj, name) {
    pick_mat <- function(o) {
      m2 <- try(as.matrix(o$samples2), silent=TRUE)
      if (!inherits(m2,"try-error") && any(grepl(paste0("^",name,"\\["), colnames(m2)))) return(m2)
      m1 <- try(as.matrix(o$samples),  silent=TRUE)
      if (!inherits(m1,"try-error") && any(grepl(paste0("^",name,"\\["), colnames(m1)))) return(m1)
      return(NULL)
    }
    M <- pick_mat(out_obj)
    if (is.null(M)) return(NULL)
    cols <- grep(paste0("^",name,"\\["), colnames(M), value=TRUE)
    idx_str <- sub(paste0("^",name,"\\["), "", cols)
    idx_str <- sub("\\]$","", idx_str)
    split   <- strsplit(idx_str, ",\\s*")
    pt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split, function(v) as.integer(v)))
    arr <- array(NA_real_, dim=c(nrow(M), P, Tt))
    for (j in seq_along(cols)) {
      p <- pt[j,1]; t <- pt[j,2]
      if (p>=1 && p<=P && t>=1 && t<=Tt) arr[,p,t] <- M[, cols[j]]
    }
    miss <- which(is.na(arr[1,,]), arr.ind=TRUE)
    list(arr=arr, missing=miss)
  }

  # Posterior mean ln-sd per (p,t) for convenience
  sigma_post_mean_PT <- NULL
  missing_sigma_idx  <- NULL
  if (SIGMA_MODE == 0L) {
    sigma_post_mean_PT <- sigma_fixed_PT
  } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 1L) {
    M <- as.matrix(out$samples2)
    cols <- grep("^sigma_obs_pl\\[", colnames(M), value=TRUE)
    post_pl <- colMeans(M[, cols, drop=FALSE])
    sigma_post_mean_PT <- matrix(as.numeric(post_pl), nrow=P, ncol=Tt)
  } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 2L) {
    ext <- .extract_any(out, "sigma_obs_tv")
    if (is.null(ext)) {
      ext <- .extract_any(out, "log_sigma")
      if (!is.null(ext)) {
        sigma_post_mean_PT <- apply(exp(ext$arr), c(2,3), mean, na.rm=TRUE)
        missing_sigma_idx  <- ext$missing
      }
    } else {
      sigma_post_mean_PT <- apply(ext$arr, c(2,3), mean, na.rm=TRUE)
      missing_sigma_idx  <- ext$missing
    }
  } else if (SIGMA_MODE == 3L) {
    sigma_post_mean_PT <- matrix(consts$sigma_scalar, nrow=P, ncol=Tt)
  }

  list(
    mcmc            = out,
    elapsed         = elapsed,
    elapsed_seconds = as.numeric(elapsed, units="secs"),
    y_PT            = y_PT,
    kernels         = list(g=g, d=d),
    sigma_mode      = sigma_mode,
    sigma_fixed_PT  = if (SIGMA_MODE==0L) sigma_fixed_PT else NULL,
    sigma_scalar    = if (SIGMA_MODE==3L) sigma_scalar else NULL,
    sigma_post_mean_PT = sigma_post_mean_PT,
    missing_sigma_idx  = missing_sigma_idx,
    extract_array      = function(name) .extract_any(out, name)$arr
  )
}
```

```{r}
)

fitB_cpl <- fit_rsv_renewal_nimble(
  y = y_kf_cpl_TxP,
  y_is_T_by_P = TRUE,
  sigma_mode = "fixed",
  sigma_input = sdlog_TxP_cpl,
  iter = 30000, nchains = 4
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Convergence summary by families (Rt, It, beta, sigma_eps, k, [sigma_obs_pl])
#   - MPSRF (multivariate R-hat) per family when p>1 and >=2 chains
#   - Rhat_max (max univariate R-hat) per family when >=2 chains
#   - relMCSE for scalar families = (sd/sqrt(ESS)) / |mean|
#     * ESS via coda::effectiveSize en cadenas combinadas
#     * Si mean ~ 0, dividimos por 'tiny' para evitar infs
# ============================================================
gr_table_from_mcmc_ultra <- function(
  mcmc_container,
  prefer_samples2_for = c("Rt","beta","sigma_obs_pl"),
  include_sigma_obs_pl = FALSE,
  drop_t1_for_It = TRUE,
  thr_rhat = 1.10,
  ridge = 1e-8,
  quiet = TRUE,
  tiny = 1e-8
){
  `%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

  as_chain_mats <- function(obj) {
    if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
    if (inherits(obj, "mcmc"))      return(list(as.matrix(obj)))
    if (inherits(obj, "mcmc.list")) return(lapply(obj, function(ch) as.matrix(ch)))
    NULL
  }

  align_chains <- function(mats, quiet = TRUE) {
    if (is.null(mats) || !length(mats)) return(NULL)
    cols_list <- lapply(mats, colnames)
    common <- Reduce(intersect, cols_list)
    if (!length(common)) {
      if (!quiet) message("No common variables; returning 0-col matrices.")
      n_vec <- sapply(mats, nrow)
      return(lapply(n_vec, function(nr) matrix(numeric(0), nrow = nr, ncol = 0,
                                               dimnames = list(NULL, character(0)))))
    }
    ref  <- colnames(mats[[1]])
    ord  <- order(match(common, ref))
    keep <- common[ord]
    nmin <- min(sapply(mats, nrow))
    lapply(mats, function(M) {
      M2 <- M[seq_len(nmin), keep, drop = FALSE]
      storage.mode(M2) <- "double"
      M2
    })
  }

  subset_by_pattern <- function(mats, pattern) {
    if (is.null(mats)) return(NULL)
    lapply(mats, function(M) {
      if (!ncol(M)) return(M[, 0, drop = FALSE])
      idx <- grep(pattern, colnames(M))
      if (!length(idx)) return(M[, 0, drop = FALSE])
      M[, idx, drop = FALSE]
    })
  }

  drop_time1_cols <- function(mats, var_prefix = "It") {
    if (is.null(mats)) return(NULL)
    pat_t1 <- paste0("^", var_prefix, "\\[\\s*\\d+\\s*,\\s*1\\s*\\]$")
    lapply(mats, function(M) {
      if (!ncol(M)) return(M)
      keep <- which(!grepl(pat_t1, colnames(M)))
      if (!length(keep)) return(M[, 0, drop = FALSE])
      M[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    })
  }

  has_vars  <- function(mats) !is.null(mats) && length(mats) > 0 && ncol(mats[[1]]) > 0
  n_chains  <- function(mats) if (is.null(mats)) 0L else length(mats)

  rhat_univar <- function(mats) {
    m <- length(mats); if (m < 2L) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(mats[[1]])))
    n <- nrow(mats[[1]]); if (n < 2L) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(mats[[1]])))
    p <- ncol(mats[[1]])
    means <- sapply(mats, colMeans); if (!is.matrix(means)) means <- matrix(means, nrow = p)
    overall <- rowMeans(means)
    s2j <- sapply(mats, function(M) apply(M, 2, stats::var)); if (!is.matrix(s2j)) s2j <- matrix(s2j, nrow = p)
    W <- rowMeans(s2j)
    B <- n/(m - 1) * rowSums((means - overall)^2)
    Vhat <- ((n - 1)/n) * W + B/n
    Rhat <- sqrt(Vhat / W)
    bad  <- !is.finite(Rhat) | W <= 0
    if (any(bad)) {
      Rhat[bad & W == 0 & B == 0] <- 1
      Rhat[bad & !(W == 0 & B == 0)] <- NA_real_
    }
    as.numeric(Rhat)
  }

  mpsrf <- function(mats, ridge = 1e-8) {
    m <- length(mats); if (m < 2L) return(NA_real_)
    n <- nrow(mats[[1]]); if (n < 2L) return(NA_real_)
    p <- ncol(mats[[1]]); if (p == 0L) return(NA_real_)
    if (p == 1L) return(suppressWarnings(max(rhat_univar(mats), na.rm = TRUE)))
    S_list <- lapply(mats, function(M) if (nrow(M) < 2L) matrix(0, ncol(M), ncol(M)) else stats::cov(M))
    W <- Reduce("+", S_list) / m
    mu_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(mats, colMeans))
    mu_bar <- rowMeans(mu_mat)
    Cmu <- mu_mat - mu_bar
    B <- (n/(m - 1)) * (Cmu %*% t(Cmu))
    Vhat <- ((n - 1)/n) * W + (1/n) * B
    Wr <- W + diag(ridge * max(1e-12, mean(diag(W))), nrow(W))
    ev <- try(base::eigen(solve(Wr, Vhat), only.values = TRUE)$values, silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(ev, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)
    sqrt(max(Re(ev), na.rm = TRUE))
  }

  # ---------- MCSE helpers (scalar only) ----------
  rel_mcse_scalar <- function(mats, tiny = 1e-8) {
    # Combina cadenas a mcmc.list y usa coda::effectiveSize
    stopifnot(requireNamespace("coda", quietly = TRUE))
    if (is.null(mats) || !length(mats)) return(NA_real_)
    # si hay >1 columnas, no es escalar -> NA
    if (ncol(mats[[1]]) != 1L) return(NA_real_)
    # construir mcmc.list
    mlist <- coda::mcmc.list(lapply(mats, coda::mcmc))
    x_all <- as.numeric(do.call(rbind, lapply(mats, as.matrix))[, 1])
    mu    <- mean(x_all)
    sdall <- stats::sd(x_all)
    ess   <- as.numeric(coda::effectiveSize(mlist))
    if (!is.finite(ess) || ess <= 0) return(NA_real_)
    mcse  <- sdall / sqrt(ess)
    rel   <- mcse / max(abs(mu), tiny)
    as.numeric(rel)
  }

  # Detect & align sources
  samples  <- NULL
  samples2 <- NULL
  if (inherits(mcmc_container, "mcmc.list") || inherits(mcmc_container, "mcmc")) {
    samples <- mcmc_container
  } else if (is.list(mcmc_container) && (!is.null(mcmc_container$samples) || !is.null(mcmc_container$samples2))) {
    samples  <- mcmc_container$samples
    samples2 <- mcmc_container$samples2
  } else {
    stop("Unrecognized object: pass fit$mcmc or an mcmc.list.")
  }

  mats1 <- align_chains(as_chain_mats(samples),  quiet = quiet)
  mats2 <- align_chains(as_chain_mats(samples2), quiet = quiet)

  # Patterns (families)
  pat <- list(
    Rt        = "^Rt\\[",
    It        = "^It\\[",
    beta      = "^beta(\\[|$)",
    sigma_eps = "^sigma_eps(\\[|$)",
    k         = "^k(\\[|$)"
  )
  if (isTRUE(include_sigma_obs_pl)) pat$sigma_obs_pl <- "^sigma_obs_pl(\\[|$)"

  choose_source <- function(fam) if (fam %in% prefer_samples2_for) mats2 %||% mats1 else mats1

  fam_stats <- purrr::imap(pat, function(regex, fam) {
    base <- choose_source(fam)
    if (is.null(base)) return(list(mpsrf = NA_real_, rhat_max = NA_real_, relMCSE = NA_real_))

    sub <- subset_by_pattern(base, regex)
    if (fam == "It" && isTRUE(drop_t1_for_It)) sub <- drop_time1_cols(sub, "It")
    if (!has_vars(sub) || n_chains(sub) < 2L) return(list(mpsrf = NA_real_, rhat_max = NA_real_, relMCSE = NA_real_))

    rvec <- rhat_univar(sub)
    rmax <- suppressWarnings(max(rvec, na.rm = TRUE)); if (!is.finite(rmax)) rmax <- NA_real_
    mps  <- mpsrf(sub, ridge = ridge)

    # relMCSE sólo si la familia es escalar (exactamente 1 columna)
    rel  <- tryCatch(rel_mcse_scalar(sub, tiny = tiny), error = function(e) NA_real_)

    list(mpsrf = mps, rhat_max = rmax, relMCSE = rel)
  })

  fam_order <- c("Rt","It","beta","sigma_eps","k", if (isTRUE(include_sigma_obs_pl)) "sigma_obs_pl")
  tibble::tibble(
    variable    = fam_order,
    Rhat_multi  = purrr::map_dbl(variable, ~ fam_stats[[.x]]$mpsrf %||% NA_real_),
    Rhat_max    = purrr::map_dbl(variable, ~ fam_stats[[.x]]$rhat_max %||% NA_real_),
    relMCSE     = purrr::map_dbl(variable, ~ fam_stats[[.x]]$relMCSE %||% NA_real_)
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Rhat      = dplyr::if_else(is.finite(Rhat_multi), Rhat_multi, Rhat_max),
      Converged = dplyr::if_else(is.finite(Rhat) & Rhat <= thr_rhat, "Yes", "No")
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(variable, Rhat, Rhat_multi, Rhat_max, relMCSE, Converged)
}

# ======================
# Uso (ejemplo A–C)
# ======================
gr_list <- list(
  A = gr_table_from_mcmc_ultra(fitA_cpd$mcmc, include_sigma_obs_pl = TRUE),
  B = gr_table_from_mcmc_ultra(fitB_cpd$mcmc, include_sigma_obs_pl = FALSE)
)

gr_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  purrr::imap(gr_list, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x, Model = .y))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Model = dplyr::recode(Model,
      A = "BCPD, σ_y (bayes)",
      B = "FE, P̂_t"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(Rhat, Rhat_multi, Rhat_max, relMCSE), ~ round(.x, 3))) |>
  dplyr::select(Model, variable, Rhat, Rhat_multi, Rhat_max, relMCSE, Converged) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Rhat))

print(gr_all)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# It/Rt vs Viral Load (p. ej., B gc/day)
# ============================================================

ci_tbl_from_summary <- function(fit, var = c("It","Rt"), dates, plant_names) {
  var <- match.arg(var)
  stopifnot(!is.null(fit$mcmc$summary$all.chains))

  summ <- fit$mcmc$summary$all.chains %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("par")

  summ <- summ %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl(paste0("^", var, "\\["), par)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      idx = sub(paste0("^", var, "\\["), "", par),
      idx = sub("\\]$", "", idx)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate(idx, into = c("p","t"), sep = ",\\s*", remove = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p = as.integer(p),
      t = as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", t))
    )

  # chequeos
  P  <- length(plant_names)
  Tt <- length(dates)
  stopifnot(all(summ$p >= 1 & summ$p <= P), all(summ$t >= 1 & summ$t <= Tt))

  # arma tabla long en el mismo formato que tu plot usa
  out <- summ %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      WWTP = plant_names[p],
      Date = dates[t],
      mean = Mean,
      lwr  = `95%CI_low`,
      upr  = `95%CI_upp`,
      var  = var
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(WWTP, Date)

  out
}

plot_ItRt_vs_conc_paper <- function(
  fit,
  y,
  dates,
  plant_names = NULL,
  y_is_T_by_P = TRUE,
  facet_ncol = 1,
  y_missing_ref = NULL,
  facet_scales = c("free_y","fixed"),
  axis_right_label = "Viral Load (B gc/day)",
  use_summary_ci = TRUE,     # <--- NUEVO: usa 95%CI_low/upp del summary
  tbl_it = NULL,             # <--- opcional: si ya lo tienes armado
  tbl_rt = NULL              # <--- opcional: si ya lo tienes armado
){
  facet_scales <- match.arg(facet_scales)

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  })

  `%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

  # ---------- helpers ----------
  as_PT <- function(m, tp = TRUE){ m <- as.matrix(m); if (tp) t(m) else m }
  q2 <- function(x, p = c(.05, .95)) stats::quantile(x[is.finite(x)], probs = p, na.rm = TRUE)

  # ---------- shape & names ----------
  y_PT <- as_PT(y, y_is_T_by_P)
  P <- nrow(y_PT); Tt <- ncol(y_PT)
  stopifnot(length(dates) == Tt)
  if (is.null(plant_names)) plant_names <- paste0("P", seq_len(P))

  # ---------- base de missing ----------
  y_miss_ref <- y_missing_ref %||% y
  y_miss_PT  <- as_PT(y_miss_ref, y_is_T_by_P)
  stopifnot(nrow(y_miss_PT) == P, ncol(y_miss_PT) == Tt)

  # Sombras por rachas de NA
  step_days <- {
    dd <- diff(as.Date(dates))
    sd <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stats::median(dd)))
    if (!is.finite(sd) || sd <= 0) 1 else sd
  }
  make_bands_for_p <- function(p){
    miss <- is.na(y_miss_PT[p, ])
    if (!any(miss)) return(NULL)
    rl <- rle(miss)
    ends <- cumsum(rl$lengths)
    starts <- ends - rl$lengths + 1
    runs <- tibble::tibble(start = starts[rl$values], end = ends[rl$values])
    if (!nrow(runs)) return(NULL)
    tibble::tibble(
      WWTP = plant_names[p],
      xmin = as.Date(dates[runs$start]) - step_days/2,
      xmax = as.Date(dates[runs$end])   + step_days/2,
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf
    )
  }
  bands_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(P), make_bands_for_p))

  # ---------- It / Rt summary tables ----------
  if (isTRUE(use_summary_ci)) {
    if (is.null(tbl_it)) tbl_it <- ci_tbl_from_summary(fit, "It", dates, plant_names)
    if (is.null(tbl_rt)) tbl_rt <- ci_tbl_from_summary(fit, "Rt", dates, plant_names)
  } else {
    stop("Si use_summary_ci=FALSE, entonces necesitas pasar tbl_it y tbl_rt ya armadas.")
  }

  # ---------- overlay (concentración / carga viral) en long ----------
  conc_tbl <- tibble::as_tibble(t(y_PT), .name_repair = "minimal")
  names(conc_tbl) <- plant_names
  conc_tbl <- conc_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Date = dates) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "WWTP", values_to = "conc_val")

  # ---------- mapeos (a,b)
  map_global <- (function(){
    # Rt: usa rango (mean) para escalar el overlay
    r_q  <- q2(tbl_rt$mean, c(.05, .95))
    c_qR <- q2(conc_tbl$conc_val, c(.00, .95))
    a_R  <- if (diff(c_qR) > 0) (r_q[2] - 0) / (c_qR[2] - 0) else 1
    b_R  <- 0

    # It
    i_q  <- q2(tbl_it$mean, c(.05, .95))
    c_qI <- q2(conc_tbl$conc_val, c(.00, .95))
    a_I  <- if (diff(c_qI) > 0) (i_q[2] - i_q[1]) / (c_qI[2] - c_qI[1]) else 1
    b_I  <- i_q[1] - a_I * c_qI[1]
    list(a_R=a_R,b_R=b_R,a_I=a_I,b_I=b_I)
  })()

  calc_map_one <- function(df_left, df_right, plant){
    li <- df_left  |> dplyr::filter(WWTP == plant) |> dplyr::pull(mean)
    ri <- df_right |> dplyr::filter(WWTP == plant) |> dplyr::pull(conc_val)
    r_q <- stats::quantile(li[is.finite(li)], probs = c(.05,.95), na.rm = TRUE)
    c_q <- stats::quantile(ri[is.finite(ri)], probs = c(.00,.95), na.rm = TRUE)
    a   <- if ((c_q[2]-c_q[1]) > 0) (r_q[2]-r_q[1])/(c_q[2]-c_q[1]) else 1
    b   <- r_q[1] - a*c_q[1]
    list(a=a,b=b)
  }
  maps_by_plant <- setNames(lapply(plant_names, \(p) calc_map_one(tbl_it, conc_tbl, p)), plant_names)

  conc_for_R <- conc_tbl
  conc_for_I <- conc_tbl

  if (facet_scales == "free_y" && P > 1) {
    conc_for_R <- conc_for_R |>
      dplyr::group_by(WWTP) |>
      dplyr::mutate(y_overlay = maps_by_plant[[WWTP[1]]]$a * conc_val + 0) |>
      dplyr::ungroup()

    conc_for_I <- conc_for_I |>
      dplyr::group_by(WWTP) |>
      dplyr::mutate(y_overlay = maps_by_plant[[WWTP[1]]]$a * conc_val + maps_by_plant[[WWTP[1]]]$b) |>
      dplyr::ungroup()

    sec_map <- if (P == 1) {
      list(
        a_I = maps_by_plant[[plant_names]]$a, b_I = maps_by_plant[[plant_names]]$b,
        a_R = maps_by_plant[[plant_names]]$a, b_R = 0
      )
    } else map_global
  } else {
    conc_for_R <- conc_for_R %>% mutate(y_overlay = map_global$a_R * conc_val + map_global$b_R)
    conc_for_I <- conc_for_I %>% mutate(y_overlay = map_global$a_I * conc_val + map_global$b_I)
    sec_map    <- map_global
  }

  # ---------- theme ----------
  base_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  # ---------- Rt plot (ribbon usa 95% CI del summary) ----------
  p_rt <- ggplot() +
    { if (nrow(bands_df)) geom_rect(data = bands_df,
                                   aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                                   inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.35) } +
    geom_ribbon(data = tbl_rt, aes(Date, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = "orange", alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(data = tbl_rt, aes(Date, mean),
              linewidth = 1.0, color = "orange4") +
    geom_line(data = conc_for_R, aes(Date, y_overlay),
              linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey30") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = facet_ncol, scales = facet_scales) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression(R[t]),
      limits = c(0, NA),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / sec_map$a_R, name = axis_right_label)
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
    labs(title = expression(R[t] ~ "vs Viral Load")) +
    xlab("Date") + base_theme

  # ---------- It plot (ribbon usa 95% CI del summary) ----------
  ymin_it <- min(tbl_it$lwr, na.rm = TRUE)
  p_it <- ggplot() +
    { if (nrow(bands_df)) geom_rect(data = bands_df,
                                   aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                                   inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.35) } +
    geom_ribbon(data = tbl_it, aes(Date, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = "#5DA5DA", alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(data = tbl_it, aes(Date, mean),
              linewidth = 1.0, color = "#2B6CB0") +
    geom_line(data = conc_for_I, aes(Date, y_overlay),
              linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey30") +
    facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = facet_ncol, scales = facet_scales) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = expression(I[t]),
      limits = c(min(sec_map$b_I, ymin_it), NA),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (.-sec_map$b_I)/sec_map$a_I, name = axis_right_label),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .05))
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
    labs(title = expression(I[t] ~ "vs Viral Load")) +
    xlab("Date") + base_theme

  list(
    p_rt = p_rt, p_it = p_it,
    tbl_rt = tbl_rt, tbl_it = tbl_it,
    map_global = map_global, maps_by_plant = maps_by_plant,
    bands = bands_df
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Scatter plot of mean differences between models
#   - Computes Δmean = mean(Model2) - mean(Model1) for Rt or It
#   - Plots Δmean over time (scatter) faceted by plant
# ============================================================

# Helper: posterior mean by (p,t) as tibble
.mean_by_pt <- function(fit, name = c("Rt","It"), dates, plant_names) {
  name <- match.arg(name)
  arr  <- fit$extract_array(name)             # draws × P × T
  if (is.null(arr)) stop("No draws for ", name)
  P <- dim(arr)[2]; Tt <- dim(arr)[3]

  mu <- apply(arr, c(2,3), function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))  # P × T
  tibble::tibble(
    p = rep(seq_len(P), each = Tt),
    t = rep(seq_len(Tt), times = P),
    WWTP = rep(plant_names, each = Tt),
    Date = rep(as.Date(dates), times = P),
    mean = as.vector(mu)
  )
}

# Main: build Δmean table (Model2 - Model1) and a scatter plot
scatter_mean_diff <- function(fit1, fit2,
                              name = c("Rt","It"),
                              dates, plant_names,
                              y_label = expression(Delta * " mean"),
                              facet_ncol = 1,
                              rope = NULL) {
  name <- match.arg(name)
  df1 <- .mean_by_pt(fit1, name, dates, plant_names) %>% dplyr::rename(mean1 = mean)
  df2 <- .mean_by_pt(fit2, name, dates, plant_names) %>% dplyr::rename(mean2 = mean)

  df  <- dplyr::left_join(df2, df1, by = c("p","t","WWTP","Date")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(delta = mean2 - mean1)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = Date, y = delta)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.5) +
    { if (!is.null(rope) && is.finite(rope) && rope > 0)
        ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = c(-rope, rope), linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.4) } +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 1.6) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ WWTP, ncol = facet_ncol, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y",
                          expand = c(0.01, 0.01), guide = ggplot2::guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = bquote(Delta~"mean"~.(name)~" (Model2 - Model1)"),
                  x = "Date", y = y_label) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

  list(data = df, plot = p)
}

# ----------------------------
# Example (adjust to your fits)
#   Compare A vs C (Model2 - Model1 = C - A) for Rt and It
# ----------------------------
plants  <- WWTP_focus
dates   <- dates

                                dates = dates, plant_names = plants,
                                rope = 25)
# Show plots
(rt_diff_AB$plot | it_diff_AB$plot)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(purrr); library(patchwork)
})

# ============================================================
# 1) Resúmenes por modelo (Rt / It)
# ============================================================
post_summ <- function(fit, name = c("Rt","It"), probs = c(.025,.5,.975),
                      plant_names = NULL, dates = NULL) {
  name <- match.arg(name)
  arr  <- fit$extract_array(name)  # draws × P × T
  if (is.null(arr)) stop("No encontré draws para ", name)
  P <- dim(arr)[2]; Tt <- dim(arr)[3]

  m   <- apply(arr, c(2,3), function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  lo  <- apply(arr, c(2,3), function(x) quantile(x, probs = probs[1], na.rm = TRUE))
  hi  <- apply(arr, c(2,3), function(x) quantile(x, probs = probs[3], na.rm = TRUE))
  med <- apply(arr, c(2,3), function(x) quantile(x, probs = 0.5,     na.rm = TRUE))

  df <- tibble::tibble(
    p = rep(seq_len(P), each = Tt),
    t = rep(seq_len(Tt), times = P),
    mean = as.numeric(m),
    median = as.numeric(med),
    lo = as.numeric(lo),
    hi = as.numeric(hi),
    param = name
  )
  if (!is.null(plant_names)) df$plant <- plant_names[df$p]
  if (!is.null(dates))       df$date  <- dates[df$t]
  df
}

# ============================================================
# 2) Diferencias entre modelos: Δ = M2 - M1 (por (p,t))
# ============================================================
post_diff <- function(fit1, fit2, name = c("Rt","It"), probs = c(.025,.5,.975),
                      rope = 0, plant_names = NULL, dates = NULL) {
  name <- match.arg(name)
  a1 <- fit1$extract_array(name)
  a2 <- fit2$extract_array(name)
  if (is.null(a1) || is.null(a2)) stop("Faltan draws para ", name)

  # Alinear número de draws (emparejar 1-a-1)
  n <- min(dim(a1)[1], dim(a2)[1])
  a1 <- a1[seq_len(n), , , drop = FALSE]
  a2 <- a2[seq_len(n), , , drop = FALSE]
  d  <- a2 - a1  # Δ por draw (iter × P × T)

  P <- dim(d)[2]; Tt <- dim(d)[3]
  m     <- apply(d, c(2,3), function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  lo    <- apply(d, c(2,3), function(x) quantile(x, probs = probs[1], na.rm = TRUE))
  hi    <- apply(d, c(2,3), function(x) quantile(x, probs = probs[3], na.rm = TRUE))
  p_gt0 <- apply(d, c(2,3), function(x) mean(x > 0,           na.rm = TRUE))
  p_out <- if (rope > 0) apply(d, c(2,3), function(x) mean(abs(x) > rope, na.rm = TRUE)) else NULL

  df <- tibble::tibble(
    p = rep(seq_len(P), each = Tt),
    t = rep(seq_len(Tt), times = P),
    mean = as.numeric(m),
    lo = as.numeric(lo),
    hi = as.numeric(hi),
    p_gt0 = as.numeric(p_gt0),
    param = name
  )
  if (!is.null(p_out)) df$p_out_rope <- as.numeric(p_out)
  if (!is.null(plant_names)) df$plant <- plant_names[df$p]
  if (!is.null(dates))       df$date  <- dates[df$t]
  df
}

# ============================================================
# 3) Plot de Δ con PUNTOS
#    - rojo si se sale del "boundary":
#      highlight = "rope"  -> |Δ_mean| > rope
#      highlight = "ci0"   -> IC95% excluye 0 (lo>0 o hi<0)
#      highlight = "both"  -> cualquiera de las dos
# ============================================================
plot_delta_points <- function(df_delta, title = "", rope = 0,
                              highlight = c("rope","ci0","both"),
                              times_new_roman = TRUE,
                              angle_labels = 45, monthly_ticks = TRUE,
                              y_label_expr = expression(Delta)) {
  stopifnot(all(c("mean","lo","hi") %in% names(df_delta)))
  highlight <- match.arg(highlight)

  has_date <- "date" %in% names(df_delta)
  aes_x <- if (has_date) aes(x = date) else aes(x = t)

  flag_rope <- if (rope > 0) abs(df_delta$mean) > rope else rep(FALSE, nrow(df_delta))
  flag_ci0  <- (df_delta$lo > 0 | df_delta$hi < 0)
  out_of_bounds <- switch(highlight,
                          rope = flag_rope,
                          ci0  = flag_ci0,
                          both = flag_rope | flag_ci0)

  df_plot <- df_delta %>% dplyr::mutate(flag = ifelse(out_of_bounds, "out", "in"))

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes_x) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.5) +
    { if (rope > 0) geom_hline(yintercept = c(-rope, rope), linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.4) } +
    geom_point(aes(y = mean, color = flag), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(NULL, values = c("in" = "black", "out" = "red")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label_expr, title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      text = element_text(family = if (times_new_roman) "Times New Roman" else NULL)
    )

  if (has_date && isTRUE(monthly_ticks)) {
    p <- p + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y",
                          expand = c(0.01, 0.01),
                          guide  = guide_axis(angle = angle_labels))
  }
  p
}
# ============================================================
# 4) Helpers para evitar repetición (plots Δ y scatters)
# ============================================================
make_delta_plot_for <- function(f1, f2, param, rope, plant_idx, plant_name, dates_vec,
                                highlight = "rope",
                                title_fmt = "%s (%s - %s), %s") {
  nm <- if (param == "Rt") "ΔRt" else "ΔIt"
  d <- post_diff(f1, f2, name = param, rope = rope,
                 plant_names = WWTP_focus_full, dates = dates_vec)
  d %>%
    dplyr::filter(p == plant_idx) %>%
    plot_delta_points(
      title = sprintf(title_fmt, nm, deparse(substitute(f2)), deparse(substitute(f1)), plant_name),
      rope = rope, highlight = highlight, times_new_roman = TRUE
    )
}

make_scatter <- function(dfX, dfY, labX, labY,
                         param = c("Rt","It"),
                         facet_ncol = 4,
                         log = c("none","log10","log1p"),
                         add_eps = 0,
                         common_limits = TRUE,
                         add_title = FALSE,
                         title_prefix = NULL,
                         swap_axes = FALSE,
                         x_code = NULL,   # <<< NUEVO: "A","B","C" para etiqueta X
                         y_code = NULL) { # <<< NUEVO: "A","B","C" para etiqueta Y
  log   <- match.arg(log)
  param <- match.arg(param)

  # ---- JOIN y selección de columnas x/y ----
  df_join <- dplyr::left_join(dfX, dfY, by = c("p","t")) %>%
    { if (!swap_axes)
        dplyr::rename(., x = dplyr::all_of(labX), y = dplyr::all_of(labY))
      else
        dplyr::rename(., x = dplyr::all_of(labY), y = dplyr::all_of(labX))
    }

  # ---- Filtrado y límites ----
  if (log == "log10") {
    if (add_eps > 0) df_join <- dplyr::mutate(df_join, x = x + add_eps, y = y + add_eps)
    df_join <- dplyr::filter(df_join, is.finite(x), is.finite(y), x > 0, y > 0)
    lims <- if (common_limits) range(c(df_join$x, df_join$y), na.rm = TRUE) else NULL
  } else if (log == "log1p") {
    df_join <- dplyr::filter(df_join, is.finite(x), is.finite(y), x >= 0, y >= 0)
    lims <- if (common_limits) range(c(df_join$x, df_join$y), na.rm = TRUE) else NULL
  } else {
    df_join <- dplyr::filter(df_join, is.finite(x), is.finite(y))
    lims <- if (common_limits) range(c(df_join$x, df_join$y), na.rm = TRUE) else NULL
  }

  # ---- Etiquetas elegantes ----
  param_lab <- if (param == "Rt") quote(R[t]) else quote(I[t])
  axis_expr <- function(code) {
    if (code == "A")      bquote("Observed, " ~ hat(sigma))
    else if (code == "B") bquote("Observed, " ~ hat(P)[t])
    else if (code == "C") bquote("Filter estimates, " ~ hat(P)[t])
    else                  bquote(.(param_lab))
  }

  # Inferir códigos de A/B/C a partir de los nombres "meanA/B/C" si no se pasan
  code_from_lab <- function(lab) sub("^mean", "", lab)  # "A","B","C"
  code_orig_X <- code_from_lab(labX)
  code_orig_Y <- code_from_lab(labY)

  # Elegir códigos finales (permitiendo override manual)
  if (is.null(x_code) && is.null(y_code)) {
    codeX <- if (!swap_axes) code_orig_X else code_orig_Y
    codeY <- if (!swap_axes) code_orig_Y else code_orig_X
  } else {
    # Si el usuario pasa x_code / y_code, respétalos tal cual
    codeX <- if (is.null(x_code)) (if (!swap_axes) code_orig_X else code_orig_Y) else x_code
    codeY <- if (is.null(y_code)) (if (!swap_axes) code_orig_Y else code_orig_X) else y_code
  }

  x_expr <- axis_expr(codeX)
  y_expr <- axis_expr(codeY)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_join, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = .5, size = 1) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ~ p, ncol = facet_ncol,
      labeller = ggplot2::labeller(p = setNames(WWTP_focus_full, 1:length(WWTP_focus_full)))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = x_expr, y = y_expr,
                  title = if (isTRUE(add_title) && !is.null(title_prefix)) title_prefix else NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::theme(text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "Times New Roman")) +
    ggplot2::coord_equal()

  if (log == "log10") {
    p <- p + ggplot2::scale_x_log10(limits = lims, expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
             ggplot2::scale_y_log10(limits = lims, expand = c(0.01, 0.01))
  } else if (log == "log1p") {
    p <- p + ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(trans = "log1p", limits = lims, expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
             ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", limits = lims, expand = c(0.01, 0.01))
  } else if (!is.null(lims)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::xlim(lims) + ggplot2::ylim(lims)
  }
  p
}

# ============================================================
# 5) Parámetros y comparaciones a generar
# ============================================================
rope_rt <- 0.05
rope_it <- 25
pl_idx  <- 1
WWTP_focus_full <- WWTP_focus  # asume mismo orden en los tres fits
pl_name <- WWTP_focus[pl_idx]  # define afuera WWTP_focus_full y dates

#p2  <- make_delta_plot_for(fitA, fitB, "It", rope_it, pl_idx, pl_name, dates, highlight = "rope")

                        x_code="C", y_code="A")
(p_rt_AB|p_it_AB)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Delays entre picos: (It vs Load) y (Rt vs Load)
# ============================================================
compute_peak_delays <- function(fit, y, dates, plants, windows,
                                y_is_T_by_P = TRUE) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr)})

  as_PT <- function(m, tp = TRUE){ m <- as.matrix(m); if (tp) t(m) else m }

  # --- extrae medias poste (draws × P × T -> P × T) ---
  It_arr <- fit$extract_array("It")
  Rt_arr <- fit$extract_array("Rt")
  stopifnot(!is.null(It_arr), !is.null(Rt_arr))
  It_mean_PT <- apply(It_arr, c(2,3), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  Rt_mean_PT <- apply(Rt_arr, c(2,3), mean, na.rm = TRUE)

  # --- carga viral (natural scale) como P × T ---
  y_PT <- as_PT(y, tp = y_is_T_by_P)   # <- FIX: usar 'tp' en vez de 'y_is_T_by_P'

  # --- a long por planta-fecha ---
  to_long <- function(M, nm) {
    tibble::as_tibble(t(M), .name_repair = "minimal") |>
      `names<-`(plants) |>
      mutate(Date = dates) |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "WWTP", values_to = nm)
  }
  df_It  <- to_long(It_mean_PT, "It_mean")
  df_Rt  <- to_long(Rt_mean_PT, "Rt_mean")
  df_L   <- to_long(y_PT, "Load")

  # --- util: fecha del máximo (primer máximo si hay empates) ---
  peak_date <- function(x, d) {
    if (all(!is.finite(x))) return(as.Date(NA))
    i <- which.max(replace(x, !is.finite(x), -Inf))
    d[i]
  }

  # --- calcular por ventana y planta ---
  win_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    window_id = names(windows),
    start = as.Date(sapply(windows, `[`, 1)),
    end   = as.Date(sapply(windows, `[`, 2))
  )

  res <- win_tbl |>
    tidyr::uncount(length(plants)) |>
    mutate(WWTP = rep(plants, each = nrow(win_tbl))) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      It_sub   = list(df_It  |> filter(WWTP == WWTP, Date >= start, Date <= end)),
      Rt_sub   = list(df_Rt  |> filter(WWTP == WWTP, Date >= start, Date <= end)),
      Load_sub = list(df_L   |> filter(WWTP == WWTP, Date >= start, Date <= end)),

      date_peak_It   = peak_date(It_sub$It_mean,   It_sub$Date),
      date_peak_Rt   = peak_date(Rt_sub$Rt_mean,   Rt_sub$Date),
      date_peak_Load = peak_date(Load_sub$Load,    Load_sub$Date),

      delay_It_vs_Load_weeks = as.numeric(date_peak_It - date_peak_Load, units = "days") / 7,
      delay_Rt_vs_Load_weeks = as.numeric(date_peak_Rt - date_peak_Load, units = "days") / 7
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    transmute(
      WWTP, window = window_id,
      date_peak_Rt, date_peak_It, date_peak_Load,
      delay_Rt_vs_Load_weeks = round(delay_Rt_vs_Load_weeks, 2),
      delay_It_vs_Load_weeks = round(delay_It_vs_Load_weeks,  2)
    )

  res
}

wins <- list(
  "Oct2023–Feb2024" = c(as.Date("2023-10-01"), as.Date("2024-02-29"))
)

delays_A <- compute_peak_delays(fitA, mat_rsv_cpd_b,  dates_rsv, WWTP_focus, wins, y_is_T_by_P = TRUE)
delays_B <- compute_peak_delays(fitB, y_kf_cpd_TxP_b, dates_rsv, WWTP_focus, wins, y_is_T_by_P = TRUE)
delays_C <- compute_peak_delays(fitC, y_kf_cpd_TxP_b, dates_rsv, WWTP_focus, wins, y_is_T_by_P = TRUE)
# Add a column to identify the model
delays_A <- delays_A %>% mutate(model = "A")
delays_B <- delays_B %>% mutate(model = "B")
delays_C <- delays_C %>% mutate(model = "C")
delays_A
delays_B
delays_C
```
